response.sql: WITH filtered_records AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5), got_gpt_by_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) as avg_got_gpt FROM filtered_records WHERE GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CENTROMEA), appt_pt_by_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(APPT - PT) as avg_appt_pt FROM filtered_records WHERE APPT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT (SELECT AVG(avg_got_gpt) FROM got_gpt_by_status) as final_avg_got_gpt, (SELECT AVG(avg_appt_pt) FROM appt_pt_by_status) as final_avg_appt_pt
